content: We prepared a set of 15 pairwise comparisons per evaluation session, and collected 930 pairwise evaluations (310 per personalized model) over 62 sessions. For each pair, users were given a partial recipe specification (name and 3-5 key ingredients), as well as two generated recipes labeled `A' and `B'. One recipe is generated from our baseline encoder-decoder model and one recipe is generated by one of our three personalized models (Prior Tech, Prior Name, Prior Recipe). The order of recipe presentation (A/B) is randomly selected for each question. A screenshot of the user evaluation interface is given in fig:exeval. We ask the user to indicate which recipe they find more coherent, and which recipe best accomplishes the goal indicated by the recipe name. A screenshot of this survey interface is given in fig:exeval2.
